en: The science and practice of measurement; in a fab, the group and tools that measure wafers.
zhdef: 晶圓量測的技術與部門。

en: A measurable parameter that directly determines product quality and is controlled against a specification.
zhdef: 直接影響產品品質、需依規格管控的參數。

en: Engineer who develops, validates and troubleshoots measurement recipes so results can be trusted for process control.
zhdef: 開發與驗證量測配方、確保數據可信的工程師。

en: Automated feedback/feed-forward control that adjusts process settings from measured results.
zhdef: 依量測結果自動調整製程參數的控制系統。

en: Adjusting a recipe between runs (e.g., deposition time) using the previous run's measurement.
zhdef: 依前一批量測值修正下一批製程設定。

en: Using an upstream measurement to set a downstream step, e.g., pre-CMP thickness to set polish time.
zhdef: 以前段量測值決定後段製程設定。

en: A departure of a process or measurement from its normal, controlled behavior.
zhdef: 製程或量測偏離正常受控狀態的事件。

en: The ordered sequence of layers on the wafer that the optical model must represent.
zhdef: 晶圓上各層薄膜的排列順序與組成。

en: The bulk material beneath the films, usually crystalline silicon.
zhdef: 薄膜底下的主體材料，通常為矽。

en: Deposition by alternating self-limiting surface reactions, adding a sub-monolayer per cycle.
zhdef: 以交替自限表面反應逐層沉積的方法。

en: Film thickness added per ALD cycle, typically ~0.1 nm.
zhdef: ALD 每一循環增加的膜厚。

en: Temperature range where GPC is nearly constant because reactions are self-limiting.
zhdef: GPC 幾乎不隨溫度變化的溫度區間。

en: A reaction that stops once surface sites are saturated, independent of extra dose.
zhdef: 表面位置飽和後反應自動停止。

en: Chemical reactant delivered as a vapor that supplies the film's elements.
zhdef: 提供薄膜元素的氣相化學反應物。

en: Inert-gas step that removes excess precursor and by-products between ALD pulses.
zhdef: 以惰性氣體清除殘餘前驅物與副產物。

en: Unwanted gas-phase reaction in ALD when precursors mix, giving extra, non-uniform growth.
zhdef: ALD 中前驅物混合造成的額外不均勻成長。

en: Initial cycles with little or no growth before a film starts on a surface.
zhdef: 薄膜開始成長前幾乎不沉積的初始循環。

en: Coating chamber walls after a clean so that subsequent wafers see a stable environment.
zhdef: 清機後先沉積使腔體狀態穩定。

en: Deposition from gas-phase chemical reactions on a heated surface.
zhdef: 利用氣相化學反應在基板上沉積薄膜。

zh: 電漿輔助化學氣相沉積
en: CVD using plasma to drive reactions at lower temperature.
zhdef: 以電漿促進反應的低溫 CVD。

en: Furnace CVD at reduced pressure, usually surface-reaction limited.
zhdef: 低壓爐管 CVD，多屬表面反應控制。

en: Regime where growth rate is set by surface kinetics, so it is very temperature sensitive.
zhdef: 成長速率由表面反應決定，對溫度敏感。

en: Regime where growth rate is set by gas supply to the surface, so it follows flow patterns.
zhdef: 成長速率由氣體傳輸決定，隨流場分布。

en: Exponential dependence of rate on temperature: k = k0 exp(−Ea/kT).
zhdef: 反應速率隨溫度呈指數變化。

en: Deposition by sputtering atoms from a target onto the wafer.
zhdef: 以濺射靶材原子沉積薄膜。

en: Accumulated energy through a sputter target; erosion changes rate and uniformity.
zhdef: 靶材累積使用量，影響速率與均勻性。

en: Growth of a crystalline layer that continues the substrate's crystal lattice.
zhdef: 延續基板晶格的單晶薄膜成長。

en: Thermal oxidation model x² + Ax = B(t+τ): linear when thin, parabolic when thick.
zhdef: 熱氧化成長模型：薄時線性、厚時拋物線。

en: SiO₂ grown by reacting silicon with O₂ or H₂O at high temperature.
zhdef: 矽在高溫與氧或水反應生成的氧化矽。

en: Thickness removed per unit time: (d_before − d_after)/t.
zhdef: 單位時間移除的膜厚。

en: Ratio of etch (or polish) rates between the target film and another film.
zhdef: 目標膜與停止層的蝕刻速率比。

en: In-situ signal that tells the tool when a layer has been cleared.
zhdef: 判斷蝕刻或研磨何時到達終點的訊號。

en: Etch or deposition rate depending on pattern density or aspect ratio.
zhdef: 速率隨圖形密度或深寬比改變。

en: Planarizing a wafer by combined chemical slurry and mechanical pad polishing.
zhdef: 以研磨液與研磨墊平坦化晶圓。

en: CMP removal rate ≈ Kp × pressure × velocity.
zhdef: 研磨速率約與壓力與相對速度成正比。

en: Thickness removed per unit time in CMP.
zhdef: CMP 單位時間移除的厚度。

en: Recess of a soft metal line below the surrounding dielectric after CMP, worst on wide lines.
zhdef: 寬金屬線研磨後低於周圍介電層的凹陷。

en: Thinning of dielectric in dense pattern arrays during CMP.
zhdef: 密集圖形區介電層被過度研磨變薄。

en: Variation of a parameter across one wafer, usually in percent.
zhdef: 單片晶圓內的參數變異。

en: Light-sensitive polymer film patterned by lithography.
zhdef: 經曝光顯影形成圖形的感光高分子膜。

en: Oscillation of dose-to-clear or CD with resist thickness, period λ/(2n).
zhdef: CD 隨光阻厚度週期性振盪的曲線。

en: Layer under resist that suppresses reflections and standing waves.
zhdef: 抑制反射與駐波的光阻下層。

en: The controlled width of a patterned feature.
zhdef: 圖形關鍵寬度。

en: Measuring film thickness from the wavelength-dependent reflectance R(λ).
zhdef: 由反射率光譜推算膜厚。

en: Fraction of incident light intensity reflected by the sample.
zhdef: 入射光被反射的比例。

en: Amplitude reflection/transmission ratios (r_s, r_p) at an interface between two media.
zhdef: 兩介質界面的振幅反射與穿透係數。

en: n₀ sin θ₀ = n₁ sin θ₁: how light bends crossing an interface.
zhdef: 光通過界面時的折射關係。

en: Superposition of reflections from the top and bottom of a film, making R vary with λ and d.
zhdef: 上下界面反射光疊加形成的干涉。

en: A maximum or minimum of reflectance caused by thin-film interference.
zhdef: 薄膜干涉造成的反射率極大或極小。

en: Integer m in 2nd cosθ = mλ; a fit on the wrong order gives a thickness jump of about λ/(2n).
zhdef: 干涉級數；選錯會使膜厚跳動約 λ/2n。

en: Closed-form reflection coefficient of a single film including multiple internal reflections.
zhdef: 含多重反射的單層膜反射係數公式。

en: Method that multiplies layer matrices to compute the optical response of a multilayer.
zhdef: 以矩陣相乘計算多層膜光學響應。

en: Measures the change in polarization (Ψ, Δ) on reflection to infer thickness and optical constants.
zhdef: 量測反射後偏振改變以推算膜厚與光學常數。

en: Ellipsometric angle with tan Ψ = |r_p|/|r_s|.
zhdef: p 與 s 反射振幅比的角度。

en: Ellipsometric phase difference between p and s reflections; very sensitive to thin films.
zhdef: p 與 s 反射的相位差，對超薄膜很敏感。

en: Light polarized perpendicular to the plane of incidence.
zhdef: 電場垂直入射面的偏振。

en: Light polarized parallel to the plane of incidence.
zhdef: 電場平行入射面的偏振。

en: Angle where p-reflection is minimal; tan θ_B = n₂/n₁ (~75.5° for Si).
zhdef: p 偏振反射最小的入射角。

en: Angle between the incoming beam and the surface normal.
zhdef: 入射光與法線的夾角。

en: 4×4 matrix describing the full polarization response, including depolarization and anisotropy.
zhdef: 描述完整偏振響應的 4×4 矩陣。

en: Loss of polarization purity from thickness variation, roughness or backside reflection.
zhdef: 因不均勻或背面反射使偏振度下降。

en: Real part of the complex index; ratio of light speed in vacuum to that in the material.
zhdef: 複折射率實部，描述光速變慢程度。

en: Imaginary part of the complex index; describes absorption.
zhdef: 複折射率虛部，描述吸收。

en: The pair n and k (or ε₁, ε₂) versus wavelength for a material.
zhdef: 材料隨波長變化的 n 與 k。

en: Complex ε = ε₁ + iε₂ = ñ²; the material response used in models.
zhdef: 複介電常數，等於複折射率平方。

en: α = 4πk/λ; 1/α is the penetration depth.
zhdef: α=4πk/λ，倒數為穿透深度。

en: Depth where light intensity falls to 1/e; sets how deep optics can see.
zhdef: 光強衰減到 1/e 的深度。

en: Optical properties that depend on direction, requiring n_o and n_e in the model.
zhdef: 光學性質隨方向不同。

en: Inferring CD, height and profile from the optical response of a periodic grating.
zhdef: 由週期光柵的光學響應推算尺寸與輪廓。

en: Fourier-mode electromagnetic solver for gratings used in OCD models.
zhdef: OCD 模型使用的光柵電磁解算法。

en: Discrete directions of light scattered by a grating; RCWA truncates them.
zhdef: 光柵繞射光的離散方向。

en: Pre-computed spectra over a parameter grid, matched to measurements in production.
zhdef: 預先計算的光譜資料庫，供產線比對。

en: Angle of a feature's sidewall relative to the substrate.
zhdef: 圖形側壁與基板的夾角。

en: Repeat distance of a periodic pattern.
zhdef: 週期圖形重複的距離。

en: Whether model parameters can be uniquely determined from the data.
zhdef: 參數能否由數據唯一決定。

en: Feeding a result from one technique into another's model to break correlations.
zhdef: 將一種量測結果輸入另一模型以降低相關性。

en: Grazing-incidence X-ray reflectivity giving thickness, density and roughness.
zhdef: 低角度 X 光反射，得膜厚、密度與粗糙度。

en: XRR oscillations with period Δθ ≈ λ/(2d), giving near model-free thickness.
zhdef: XRR 振盪條紋，週期反映膜厚。

en: Angle below which X-rays are totally reflected; θc ≈ √(2δ), related to density.
zhdef: X 光全反射的臨界角，與密度相關。

en: Recursive calculation of X-ray reflectivity for a multilayer.
zhdef: 計算多層膜 X 光反射率的遞迴法。

en: Element-specific fluorescence intensity giving mass thickness and composition.
zhdef: 以元素特徵螢光量測質量厚度與成分。

en: Mass per unit area (ρ·t); what XRF actually measures.
zhdef: 單位面積質量，即密度乘厚度。

en: Infrared spectroscopy for epi thickness and chemical bonding/composition.
zhdef: 紅外光譜，用於磊晶厚度與鍵結成分。

en: IR absorption by mobile carriers; creates optical contrast between epi and doped substrate.
zhdef: 載子造成的紅外吸收，形成磊晶與基板對比。

en: Measuring surface height or step height by stylus or optical scanning.
zhdef: 以探針或光學掃描量測表面高度。

en: Scanning-tip microscope measuring height with sub-nm vertical resolution.
zhdef: 以探針掃描量測次奈米高度。

en: Height difference across an edge; a direct geometric thickness reference.
zhdef: 邊緣兩側的高度差，可作膜厚參考。

en: Top-down SEM that measures feature widths.
zhdef: 由上方量測線寬的電子顯微鏡。

zh: 穿透式／截面電子顯微鏡
en: Cross-section imaging used as an absolute (but destructive, local) thickness reference.
zhdef: 截面影像，作為破壞性絕對參考。

en: Resistance of a square of film, Rs = ρ/t; links metal thickness to electrical behavior.
zhdef: 薄膜方塊電阻，等於電阻率除以厚度。

en: Size of the measurement beam on the wafer; must fit inside the pad.
zhdef: 量測光束在晶圓上的大小。

en: Dedicated blanket or grating area (often in the scribe line) for metrology.
zhdef: 切割道上專供量測的區域。

en: Parameterized formula for n(λ), k(λ) of a material.
zhdef: 描述 n、k 隨波長變化的參數化公式。

en: n = A + B/λ² + C/λ⁴; for transparent dielectrics.
zhdef: 透明介電層的簡單色散公式。

en: Pole-based dispersion for transparent materials with better extrapolation than Cauchy.
zhdef: 以極點描述透明材料的色散。

en: KK-consistent model for amorphous materials with a band gap (a-Si, SiN, HfO₂).
zhdef: 適用於有能隙非晶材料的色散模型。

en: Free-electron dispersion for metals and doped semiconductors.
zhdef: 描述金屬與摻雜載子的色散模型。

en: Resonance term in ε used to model absorption bands.
zhdef: 描述吸收峰的共振項。

en: Mixes dielectric functions of components (e.g., film + void) for roughness or porosity.
zhdef: 混合多種材料介電函數以描述粗糙或孔隙。

en: Causality relation linking n and k; physical dispersion models obey it.
zhdef: 連結 n 與 k 的因果關係式。

en: Energy below which a semiconductor or dielectric does not absorb (k≈0).
zhdef: 低於此能量材料不吸收光。

en: Thin layer between two films (e.g., SiO₂ under high-k) that must be in the model.
zhdef: 兩層膜之間的薄層，模型需納入。

en: ~1–2 nm SiO₂ that forms on silicon in air.
zhdef: 矽在空氣中自然生成的薄氧化層。

en: Height fluctuation of a surface; modeled with an EMA layer or Névot–Croce factor.
zhdef: 表面高度起伏。

en: Fitting several thicknesses with shared n,k to decorrelate n from d.
zhdef: 多片不同厚度共用 n、k 同時擬合。

en: Controlled set of material optical constants used by recipes.
zhdef: 配方使用的材料光學常數集。

en: Light returning from the back of a transparent substrate, distorting the measurement.
zhdef: 透明基板背面反射造成的干擾。

en: Tool program defining sites, acquisition, model, fit and outputs.
zhdef: 定義量測點位、模型與輸出的程式。

en: Physical description of the stack used to compute spectra for fitting.
zhdef: 用於計算光譜的膜堆疊物理描述。

en: Adjusting model parameters to minimize the difference between measured and modeled spectra.
zhdef: 調整參數使模型光譜貼近量測。
note: 15 Residuals Fit Quality and Model Risk

en: A false best-fit solution, e.g., a wrong fringe order.
zhdef: 非全域最佳的擬合解。

en: Image-based alignment that finds the measurement site.
zhdef: 以影像對位找到量測點。

en: How much the signal changes per unit change of a parameter, compared with noise.
zhdef: 參數改變造成的訊號變化量。

en: Matrix of derivatives ∂S/∂θ used for sensitivity and covariance.
zhdef: 光譜對參數的偏微分矩陣。

en: (JᵀWJ)⁻¹: parameter uncertainties and their correlations.
zhdef: 描述參數不確定度與相關性的矩陣。

en: When two fitted parameters trade off so the data cannot separate them.
zhdef: 兩個擬合參數互相補償難以分離。

en: Measured minus modeled signal at each wavelength.
zhdef: 量測值減模型值。
note: 15 Residuals Fit Quality and Model Risk

en: Noise-weighted sum of squared residuals; reduced χ² ≈ 1 means fit within noise.
zhdef: 以雜訊加權的殘差平方和。
note: 15 Residuals Fit Quality and Model Risk

en: Vendor metric of fit quality; necessary but not sufficient for correctness.
zhdef: 擬合品質指標，必要但不充分。
note: 15 Residuals Fit Quality and Model Risk

en: A fitted parameter stuck at its allowed limit, signaling the model cannot explain the data.
zhdef: 參數擬合停在上下限，模型可能有誤。
note: 15 Residuals Fit Quality and Model Risk

en: Systematic error from wrong model assumptions, usually larger than statistical error.
zhdef: 模型假設錯誤造成的系統誤差。
note: 15 Residuals Fit Quality and Model Risk

en: Independent, more accurate method (TEM, XRR, AFM) used to validate a production recipe.
zhdef: 用來驗證產線配方的獨立準確方法。
note: 15 Residuals Fit Quality and Model Risk

en: The set of wafer coordinates measured by a recipe.
zhdef: 配方量測的晶圓座標點集合。

en: Polar map of 1 + 8 + 16 + 24 sites used for uniformity qualification.
zhdef: 中心加三圈共 49 點的量測圖。

en: Outer band of the wafer excluded from measurement and specification.
zhdef: 晶圓外緣不量測的範圍。

en: Plot of a parameter over wafer coordinates; its pattern fingerprints the process.
zhdef: 參數在晶圓上的分布圖。

en: Spread of thickness across a wafer; definitions (half-range, 1σ, 3σ) differ.
zhdef: 晶圓內厚度分散程度，定義需註明。

en: (max − min)/(2·mean) × 100 %.
zhdef: (最大−最小)/(2×平均)。

en: Map pattern thick at center, thin at edge (radial coefficient a₁ < 0).
zhdef: 中心厚邊緣薄的分布。

en: Map pattern thick at edge, thin at center (a₁ > 0).
zhdef: 邊緣厚中心薄的分布。

en: Map gradient from one side to the other, e.g., from gas-inlet asymmetry.
zhdef: 晶圓一側到另一側的線性梯度。

en: Thickness versus radius; fitted as a₀ + a₁ρ² + a₂ρ⁴.
zhdef: 厚度對半徑的變化曲線。

en: Varying around the wafer at fixed radius (e.g., lift pins, pump port).
zhdef: 在同一半徑上繞圓周的變化。

en: Orthogonal basis on a disk used to decompose wafer maps.
zhdef: 圓盤上的正交多項式，用於分解晶圓圖。

en: Rapid thickness change near the wafer edge.
zhdef: 晶圓邊緣附近厚度急遽變化。

en: Monitoring a process with control charts to detect non-random change.
zhdef: 以管制圖監控製程的非隨機變化。

en: Time plot of a statistic with control limits from the process's own variation.
zhdef: 含管制界限的時間序列圖。

en: ±3σ bounds of the plotted statistic from stable history; not the spec.
zhdef: 由穩定期數據計算的 ±3σ 界限。

en: Upper/lower acceptable values set by product requirements.
zhdef: 產品要求的上下限。

en: Pattern rules (e.g., 8 points one side) that flag non-random behavior.
zhdef: 判斷非隨機變化的管制圖規則。

en: An SPC signal when the process has not actually changed.
zhdef: 製程未變卻觸發的警報。

en: Smoothed statistic sensitive to small sustained shifts; also used in R2R control.
zhdef: 對小幅持續偏移敏感的平滑統計量。

en: Chart accumulating deviations to detect small shifts quickly.
zhdef: 累積偏差以快速偵測小偏移。

en: (USL − LSL)/6σ: spread relative to spec, ignoring centering.
zhdef: 規格寬度與 6σ 之比。

en: min(USL−μ, μ−LSL)/3σ: capability including centering.
zhdef: 考慮偏心的製程能力。

en: Capability using overall long-term σ; Ppk < Cpk signals drift or lot effects.
zhdef: 使用長期總變異的能力指標。

en: Square root of variance; sample form uses N−1.
zhdef: 變異數平方根，樣本用 N−1。

en: Splitting variation into lot, wafer, site and measurement components.
zhdef: 將變異分解為批、片、點與量測。

en: Robust spread measure; σ ≈ 1.4826 × MAD.
zhdef: 穩健的分散度量。

en: A value far from the rest; check for measurement artifacts before excluding.
zhdef: 明顯偏離其他數據的值。

en: Gradual change over time in process or measurement output.
zhdef: 隨時間緩慢變化。

en: Abrupt shift, often tied to maintenance, recipe or material change.
zhdef: 突然的偏移，常與保養或變更有關。

en: Study of how much variation the measurement itself adds.
zhdef: 評估量測本身造成的變異。

en: Study splitting measurement variation into repeatability and reproducibility.
zhdef: 將量測變異分為重複性與再現性。

en: Variation of repeated measurements on one tool and one sample.
zhdef: 同機台同樣品重複量測的變異。

en: Variation when conditions change: tool, day, operator.
zhdef: 不同機台、日期或人員間的變異。

en: Closeness of repeated results to each other (random error).
zhdef: 重複結果彼此接近程度。

en: Closeness of the result to the true value (systematic error).
zhdef: 結果接近真值的程度。

en: 6σ_meas/(USL−LSL); below ~10 % is good.
zhdef: 量測變異佔規格寬度的比例。

en: 1.41 σ_part/σ_meas; should be ≥ 5.
zhdef: 量測可區分的類別數，應≥5。

en: Statistical method that attributes variation to factors.
zhdef: 將變異歸因到各因子的統計方法。

en: Tightened acceptance limits that account for measurement uncertainty.
zhdef: 考慮量測誤差而收緊的判定界限。

en: Combined estimate of all measurement error sources.
zhdef: 綜合各誤差來源的不確定度。

en: Ensuring different metrology tools give the same result on the same wafer.
zhdef: 確保不同機台量測同一片結果一致。

en: Systematic difference between tools or versus a reference.
zhdef: 機台間或與參考值的系統差異。

en: Line fit allowing error in both x and y; right for tool-vs-tool data.
zhdef: x、y 皆有誤差時的迴歸法。

en: Plot of difference vs mean of two methods to reveal bias and slope.
zhdef: 兩方法差值對平均值作圖。

en: Adjusting an instrument against known standards so results are traceable.
zhdef: 以已知標準調整儀器。

en: Unbroken chain of calibrations back to SI units via certified standards.
zhdef: 可經標準追溯至國際單位。

en: Certified sample (e.g., SiO₂ on Si) with known thickness and uncertainty.
zhdef: 具認證值與不確定度的標準樣品。

en: Dedicated wafer measured routinely to check tool stability.
zhdef: 定期量測以確認機台穩定的晶圓。

en: Hydrocarbon/water adsorption that makes thin monitor films read thicker over time.
zhdef: 吸附使薄膜監控片讀值逐漸變厚。

en: Scheduled maintenance; a frequent cause of step changes.
zhdef: 定期保養，常造成階躍變化。

en: Formal tests proving a tool or recipe is fit for production.
zhdef: 證明機台或配方可上線的正式測試。

en: r between −1 and 1 measuring linear association; not proof of cause.
zhdef: 衡量線性關聯，非因果證明。

en: Two factors changing together so their effects cannot be separated.
zhdef: 兩因子同時變化無法分離效應。

en: Planned variation of factors to measure effects and interactions efficiently.
zhdef: 有計畫地改變因子以量化效應。

en: DOE testing all (or a fraction of) combinations of factor levels.
zhdef: 測試因子水準組合的實驗設計。

en: Lot divided into groups given different process conditions.
zhdef: 將一批晶圓分組給予不同條件。

en: Checking that metrology reports the intended process deltas with slope ≈ 1.
zhdef: 確認量測能正確反映刻意改變的差異。

en: Running DOE conditions in random order to avoid time confounding.
zhdef: 隨機排序實驗以避免時間混淆。

en: Structured search for the underlying cause of a problem.
zhdef: 系統性找出問題根本原因。

en: Table comparing where a problem occurs and where it does not, to isolate cause.
zhdef: 比對問題發生與不發生處以縮小原因。

en: Cause-and-effect brainstorming diagram (Man, Machine, Method, Material, Measurement, Environment).
zhdef: 因果分析的腦力激盪圖。

en: Asking 'why' repeatedly to reach a systemic cause.
zhdef: 連續追問為什麼找出系統性原因。

en: Formal problem-solving report: containment, root cause, corrective and preventive actions.
zhdef: 含圍堵、根因與矯正預防的正式報告。

en: Plotting data with all change events (PM, recipe, lot) as markers.
zhdef: 在趨勢圖上標註所有變更事件。

en: Equipment sensor data system used to correlate process conditions with results.
zhdef: 機台感測數據監控系統。

en: Finding which tool, chamber or material all affected lots share.
zhdef: 找出異常批共同經過的機台或材料。

en: Immediate action to stop bad material spreading (hold lots, stop chamber).
zhdef: 立即阻止不良擴散的行動。

en: Bringing a new product or process into manufacturing.
zhdef: 將新產品或製程導入量產。

en: Predefined steps to take when a control chart signals.
zhdef: 管制圖異常時的預定處理步驟。

en: Full-scale production, where throughput and robustness dominate.
zhdef: 大規模量產階段。

en: Wafers measured per hour; trades against sampling density.
zhdef: 每小時量測片數。

en: Formal review and record of any recipe, model or library change.
zhdef: 配方或模型變更的正式審查流程。

en: Team that owns the full process flow and device results.
zhdef: 負責整體製程流程與元件結果的團隊。

en: Fraction of good dies or wafers.
zhdef: 合格晶粒或晶圓的比例。

en: Site term for engineering/evaluation lots run outside normal production.
zhdef: 工程評估用的特殊批次需求。

en: Fab software tracking lots, recipes and data.
zhdef: 追蹤批次與配方的工廠系統。

en: Common dielectric; n ≈ 1.457 at 633 nm; stable optical reference.
zhdef: 常見介電層，折射率約 1.457。

en: Dielectric with n ≈ 1.9–2.1; PECVD composition shifts n.
zhdef: 氮化矽介電層，折射率約 2.0。

en: Gate/capacitor dielectrics such as HfO₂ with higher permittivity than SiO₂.
zhdef: 介電常數高於氧化矽的材料。

en: Polycrystalline silicon; optical model often an EMA of c-Si, a-Si and voids.
zhdef: 多晶矽，常用 EMA 模型描述。

en: Non-crystalline silicon; higher n and k than c-Si in the visible.
zhdef: 非晶態矽。

en: Metallic barrier/electrode film; Drude-like optics, often measured by XRF.
zhdef: 金屬性阻障層，常以 XRF 量測。

en: Epitaxial alloy where Ge fraction and thickness can correlate in optical fits.
zhdef: 矽鍺磊晶，Ge 比例與厚度易相關。

en: Thin dielectric under the gate; capacitance C_ox = ε/t_ox.
zhdef: 閘極下方的薄介電層。
